title: feat: add exponential backoff retry for payment gateway timeouts
author: sarah.chen@northstar.internal
description: Introduces configurable exponential backoff with full jitter for transient 502/504 errors from upstream acquirers. Caps maximum retries at 3 attempts with a 500ms max ceiling to prevent thread exhaustion during payment authorization spikes.
diff_summary:
+ class ExponentialBackoffPolicy:
+     max_attempts: int = 3
+     base_delay_ms: int = 100
+     max_delay_ms: int = 500
+     def get_delay(self, attempt: int) -> float: ...
- def call_acquirer(payload):
-     return http.post(payload, timeout=2.0)
+ def call_acquirer_with_retry(payload):
+     ... retry loop with idempotency key ...

title: fix: update fraud risk score threshold to reduce false positive challenges
author: marcus.vance@northstar.internal
description: Adjusts the 3DS verification challenge threshold from 70 to 78 for low-ticket transactions (< $50) based on analysis from the Q3 fraud audit. Lowers cart abandonment by an estimated 4.2% while keeping fraud rate within the 0.05% margin.

title: refactor: optimize redis cache lookup in pricing-service
author: elena.rostova@northstar.internal
description: Batches individual item price queries into a single Redis MGET / pipeline operation. Reduces P99 pricing latency from 95ms down to 32ms during multi-item cart calculation.
diff_summary:
- for item in cart.items:
-     price = redis.get(item.sku)
+ skus = [item.sku for item in cart.items]
+ prices = redis.mget(skus)
